title: Chapter 280 The Three-Headed Dog Of Hell'S Round Battle
content:
Chapter 280 The Three-Headed Dog Of Hell'S Round Battle

Hazamu turned around and said to Wang Shuo: "Human, you have successfully angered me. You are qualified to be transformed into an undead by me!"

"Hmph, I don't think you have this chance!"

Wang Shuo charged again.

At the same time, he activated the "Flame Shield" to at least improve his defense.

Just when he was about to get close to his opponent, he activated the "Iron Chain Binding".

This time, the skill sneak attack made Hazamu's body stiff. Wang Shuo seized the opportunity and immediately performed the "Dragon Strike."

"-3200"

Wang Shuo's current level has reached level 36. His normal attack was originally only more than 540, but with the double blessing of the second-level "Black Dragon Sutra", it directly reached more than 1100.

Although it is still not as good as the level 55 gold boss, it is almost the same.

At the same time, the "Dragon Strike" with five times the attribute damage can even deal 4000 damage.

I have to say that the "Black Dragon Sutra" is really awesome!

Hazamu was shocked. He had lost one sixth of his health. This was a great shame.

The three-headed dog of hell also took the opportunity to release "corrosive poison" and "flaming burning". The first skill caused more than 1,000 damage, and continued to corrode the opponent's body every second, causing continuous blood loss.

But the second skill was completely immune.

Then, the angry Hazamu also directly launched the skill "Hell Flame".

"Let you see who is from hell!"

This skill directly knocked out more than 3,000 of Wang Shuo's health, which was considered a counterattack for Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo's current total health is only 5,000, which is going to kill Wang Shuo.

Little Haba immediately spit out the healing "healing gas" to restore Wang Shuo's health.

The healing gas restores 1,000 health points every minute. Although it is slow, it lasts long!

But at this time, Wang Shuo had to take out the recovery pill to replenish his blood volume to more than 80%, otherwise he would be killed instantly by the opponent's next skill, and he would have no time to cry.

The two fought several times, and they were really angry. Although Wang Shuo was defeated, he could still hold on.

In order to buy time for the three-headed dog troops and eliminate the skeleton soldiers, Wang Shuo had used up 2 drops of water of life.

He was covered in blood, and there was a deep wound on the back of the three-headed dog of hell.

But everything was worth it.

In a team battle, if you can't focus on the hero, you can only kill the soldiers first, and then surround the hero.

At this moment, the skeleton soldiers near the altar were finally eliminated.

Wang Shuo smiled.

In order to prevent Hazamu from escaping, Wang Shuo directly launched the "Iron Chain Binding" to trap him first, and then launched the "Abyss Swamp" to bind him.

In the two seconds of being "Iron Chain Binding", his body continued to sink into the swamp.

Afterwards, all the hellhounds surrounded the swamp and took turns using their skills, but falling into the swamp weakened the damage of the "corrosive poison mist" to him.

Finally, the opponent's entire body fell into the swamp.

Wang Shuo frowned.

Judging from Hazamu's various attributes, this swamp would definitely not be able to trap him.

Wang Shuo can now easily break free from the swamp. He only needs to be given a little support, and he can jump up with his super high agility attribute.

It just takes some effort to escape from the swamp.

I don't know what Hazamu is up to.

He actually hid in the swamp.

"Everyone be careful!"

Wang Shuo saw bubbles appearing in the swamp and the position was moving.
